title: Exploring Rome | ElSyifa Honeymoon Vlog - Part 1
description:
Hi guys! 🤍

Here’s the vlog you’ve all been waiting for!! 🥹 Thank you so much for being so patient.

We hope you enjoy watching as much as we enjoyed living it. ❤️

Love,
El & Syifa
